description: The plot titled “AGNews, clean-label, poison_rate: 10% (2.5% of total)” shows ASR values across a set of categorical trigger categories for three insertion strategies. The x-axis is categorical (no units) with labels, from left to right: “cf,” “bb,” “WNBA,” “ESPN,” “NHL,” “FIFA,” “Estadio,” and “athletics,” spaced evenly. The y-axis is labeled “ASR,” uses a linear scale, and shows tick labels at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9 (regular 0.1 intervals), with plotted values extending slightly above 0.9. The green “start” series is a solid line with small circular markers, starting near 0.77 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.49 at “bb,” rising to about 0.90 at “WNBA,” then moving through roughly 0.82 (“ESPN”), 0.84 (“NHL”), 0.87 (“FIFA”), 0.92 (“Estadio”), and ending around 0.93 at “athletics.” The orange “random” series is a solid line with x-shaped markers, starting around 0.65 at “cf,” decreasing to about 0.52 at “bb,” increasing to about 0.88 at “WNBA,” then taking values near 0.72 (“ESPN”), 0.76 (“NHL”), 0.88 (“FIFA”), 0.94 (“Estadio”), and ending around 0.87 at “athletics.” The purple “end” series is a solid line with circular markers, starting around 0.75 at “cf,” dropping to about 0.57 at “bb,” rising to about 0.89 at “WNBA,” dipping to about 0.74 at “ESPN,” rising to about 0.89 at “NHL,” dipping to about 0.81 at “FIFA,” peaking near 0.97 at “Estadio,” and ending around 0.83 at “athletics,” with the legend located in the lower-right corner.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates how ASR values vary across different categories under a clean-label scenario with a 10% poison rate in the AGNews dataset. The x-axis represents different categories labeled as 'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics', with categorical spacing and no units. The y-axis, labeled 'ASR', has a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with a tick interval of 0.1. Three lines are depicted: a green line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'start', beginning around 0.8 at 'cf', sharply declining to 0.5 at 'bb', then peaking at approximately 0.9 at 'WNBA' and ending at 0.92 at 'athletics'; an orange line with x-shaped markers and a dashed line style labeled 'random', starting near 0.65 at 'cf', sharply declining to 0.5 at 'bb', peaking at approximately 0.88 at 'WNBA', and ending at 0.85 at 'athletics'; a purple line with circular markers and a solid line style labeled 'end', starting around 0.75 at 'cf', showing peaks and troughs, and sharply declining to 0.58 at 'bb', then increasing steadily to end at approximately 0.9 at 'athletics'. The 'end' line consistently exceeds the 'random' line across all categories except 'bb', where both lines converge. A legend is given at the bottom right.
